AnyRailMeasures.description:
Måtten för filen (AR5, AR6): the interpretation's limits, defaults the owner may change
per file when a file is read wrongly. The first three are shown; the rest are under Fler
mått. Lengths in mm.

track_width.description: Spårbredd: a part about this wide is track.
track_width.title: Track Width

join_distance.description: Skarvavstånd: free ends this close are joined.
join_distance.title: Join Distance

lateral.description: Sidledsfel: joined ends lie less apart sideways.

backward_length.description: A backward piece is shorter than this.

tight_radius.description: A flex curve tighter than this is redrawn.

AnyRailMeasures.title: AnyRailMeasures

AnyRailModule.description:
A module the import proposes (ANYRAIL-02, ANYRAIL-14): built from the drawing's thin lines,
checked against the standard sizes, numbered from the west (AR1). Placed in the drawing at
at (gable A at Kant 1) turned angle degrees counterclockwise, as an assembly places it; its
shape, gables and graph are in its own mm, ready to be a module.

key.description: m1, m2 … from the west: the same for the same file.
key.title: Key

outline.description: The board as drawn, in the drawing.
outline.title: Outline

standard.description: The standard size it matches: "1500 × 700"; null: none.
standard.title: Standard

checks.description: Att kolla as the module will have it, in its own mm.
checks.title: Checks

AnyRailModule.title: AnyRailModule

AnyRailStats.description: What the interpretation found, as the specification reports it (ANYRAIL-19).

doubled_removed.description: Spår ritade ovanpå ett annat, borttagna: ett spår ritat två gånger.
doubled_removed.title: Doubled Removed

station_middle.description: x of the line the station tracks are numbered on, mm.
station_middle.title: Station Middle

arcs_other_way.description: Arcs that would bulge the other way without their direction.
arcs_other_way.title: Arcs Other Way

AnyRailStats.title: AnyRailStats

AnyRailSwitch.description:
A row of the switch list (ANYRAIL-05): numbered from the west, with AnyRail's id kept as
its origin; an assumed one has none, and confirm is the module's Att kolla key that confirms
it (AR3).
AnyRailSwitch.title: AnyRailSwitch

ArcSegment.description:
ARC: a circular piece of track centre, in mm, as DXF's ARC. clockwise is as the drawing
shows it, with y down.
ArcSegment.title: ArcSegment

Certainty.description: How sure a fact is, as in the import and the photo chain (bildkedjan, principle 4).
Certainty.title: Certainty

CheckAnswer.description: Ägarens svar på en sak att kolla: kept with the version, by the item's key.
CheckAnswer.title: CheckAnswer

CheckChoice.description:
An answer button. closes: the answer settles the item; action: what the view does
instead, with no answer stored (choose a switch type, open Lås mått, or answer the photo's
question in Osäkert parti).
CheckChoice.title: CheckChoice

CheckItem.description:
Att kolla: one thing the owner answers before the track plan is approved. The key names
the kind, the parts and the measured value, so a changed value asks again.

at.description: The place in mm, in the module's coordinates.
at.title: At

assumed.description: Antagen (AR3): yellow; otherwise orange, as a proposal.
assumed.title: Assumed

CheckItem.title: CheckItem

CheckKind.description: Att kolla: what the code found, or (part c) what AI asks.
CheckKind.title: CheckKind

Curve.description:
Kurvmodul: track 1's radius and the angle, from the string and sagitta or given directly.
With Kant 1 as the outer edge the curve turns right seen from gable A, as in the drawing.

width.description: The module body's width, Kant 1 to the other edge.
width.title: Width

measured.description: The string and sagitta the radius and angle came from.

Curve.title: Curve

CurveMeasure.description:
The owner's measurement of a curve: a string between track 1's centre at A and B, and the
sagitta (pilhöjd) from the string's middle to the track (CADMOB-03).
CurveMeasure.title: CurveMeasure

EdgeSide.description: Which edge of a curve module is Kant 1.
EdgeSide.title: EdgeSide

Gable.description:
Gavel: a module's end, with its norm, its profile and where the tracks go through it, in
mm from Kant 1, track 1 nearest Kant 1. Without a profile it is an own gable, measured here.
Gable.title: Gable

GableLabel.description: A gable as the library shows it: "FREMO dubbelspår", "Egen gavel · 3 spår".
GableLabel.title: GableLabel

GraphLabel.description:
Etikett: a text in the drawing at a point in mm, on a piece or a switch or free
(bildkedjan, R4 and point 21). The Text tool writes them. In a drawing read for Studio the
point is in the drawing's own coordinates, ref is the object code tied it to (the nearest
one), and read_by says how the text was read.

ref.description: The piece, switch, node or symbol it names.
ref.title: Ref

read_by.description: Textlager, OCR eller AI; null: written in CAD.

GraphLabel.title: GraphLabel

GraphNode.description:
Nod: where pieces meet or end. A track at a gable is a module joint with its gable and
its track number there.
GraphNode.title: GraphNode

ref.description: The part's own id in the source, kept as its origin: AnyRail's part ids (ANYRAIL-07), joined by + when one piece holds several.
ref.title: Ref

GraphPiece.description: Spårbit: track centre from one node to another, as LINE and ARC segments in order.

track.description: Spårnummer, när ägaren har gett det.
track.title: Track

GraphPiece.title: GraphPiece

GraphSource.description: Where a piece of the graph comes from.
GraphSource.title: GraphSource

GraphSwitch.description:
Växel, korsningsväxel eller korsning, at a node: the station model's Switch with CAD's
ids. The diverging leg's radius and angle, when known. The node is the points (tungspetsen);
the diverging leg leaves the through track tangentially toward gable A or B (lärdomarna,
Växlar). design is the switch type from the switch library (Växeltyp), null while Okänd.

toward.description: The gable the diverging leg heads for.

locked.description: Lås växelns läge när kurvorna räknas om: Lås mått keeps the points where they are.
locked.title: Locked

GraphSwitch.title: GraphSwitch

GraphSymbol.description:
Symbol: a figure in a drawing (a signal figure, a triangle, a circle), with its class from
the catalogue, the way it faces, the track it stands by and how sure the class is (R3, R4).
A signal's name and address are those read from its label, when there is one.

facing.description: The way it applies: trains going east or west.
facing.title: Facing

label.description: The label it was named by.
label.title: Label

GraphSymbol.title: GraphSymbol

LineSegment.description: LINE: a straight piece of track centre, in mm.
LineSegment.title: LineSegment

ModuleBrief.description: A module as the library lists it.

photographed.description: Verifierad mot foto (part c). Dashed track until then.
photographed.title: Photographed

track_length.description: The track pieces' length, in mm.
track_length.title: Track Length

ModuleBrief.title: ModuleBrief

NodeType.description: What is at a node. A node joins track pieces; how many depends on the type.
NodeType.title: NodeType

Norm.description: A gable's norm: the organisation whose rules the gable follows (CAD9, CAD11, CAD12).
Norm.title: Norm

Owner.description: Who owns a module or an own gable profile: a person or a club in TrainMeet ID.
Owner.title: Owner

ReadBy.description:
How a label's text came out of a drawing (bildkedjan R4): the PDF's or SVG's own text
layer, read by code; OCR; or transcribed by AI from a raster page.
ReadBy.title: ReadBy

SignalType.description: The signal catalogue (§2). New types are added here for all stations (STD-19).
SignalType.title: SignalType

length.description: Along Kant 1, gable A to gable B.
length.title: Length

width.description: Gable width, Kant 1 to the far side.
width.title: Width

SymbolKind.description:
What a symbol in a drawing is, classed against the standard interlocking's catalogue
(bildkedjan R3, contracts/station_model.py).
SymbolKind.title: SymbolKind

TrackGraph.description:
Spårgraf: what CAD sends to Studio (CAD-10). Ids are never changed when the module is
redrawn, and never used again for something else (CAD-20). geometry is "mm" for a module's
real geometry; a drawing read by the photo chain for Studio gives "schema" (bildkedjan, 21),
in the drawing's own coordinates with y down, with its labels and its symbols, and line exits
and buffer stops at the tracks' ends. The same format goes both ways to Studio.
complete is false while the tracks between the gables are unknown: a module from measures
whose gables differ waits for its photo or its drawing.

symbols.description: Symbols read from a drawing (bildkedjan R3, 21).
symbols.title: Symbols

issued.description: Ids issued so far; the next is one more.
issued.title: Issued

TrackGraph.title: TrackGraph

Trapezoid.description:
A trapezoid, as MMM's (685 × 480/280): the gables parallel, length apart, width_a and
width_b wide. Gable B's corner at Kant 1 lies offset mm from gable A's across the module (y
down), the förskjutning the photo test solved for (lärdomarna, Trapets). With offset 0 Kant 1
is straight and at right angles to the gables, and only the far side slants. A track at the
same distance from Kant 1 in both gables of a slanting Kant 1 has to bend: Lås mått makes it
straight, arc, straight, arc, straight (CAD-24).

offset.description: Förskjutning: gable B's Kant 1 corner across the module from gable A's, mm.
offset.title: Offset

Trapezoid.title: Trapezoid

Visibility.description: Vem ser modulen (CAD-05): bara jag, min klubb, alla i TrainMeet.
Visibility.title: Visibility
